chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Nat Towles' big band in Omaha
summary: Smith says Nat Towles' band was as good as Basie's with Charlie Christian, and Towles could not play bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: So tell me about Nat Towles. There was no chance of joining his band.

I could have if I wanted to. But I would have had to push some of them other boys out of the way. I didn't want to do that. See, I never was that kind of man to come and run on nobody's job. So I let all of them other boys stay there.
What kind of a band was Nat Towles?
A good band.
Really?
Yeah. A big band. Like Basie's band..
As good as Basie?
Yeah. It sure was.
Who were the big men in Nat Towles' band then?
Charlie Christian was one of that was in there.
Buster Smith - 181
At that time?

Yeah. Charlie Christian, then they had another boy named Casey who played guitar when Charlie left. Named Casey. He played a lot of guitar, too. But he died. Oh, several of them cats there. Some of them boys I didn't know; all of them were good musicians.
Was it a band that stuck very much in the Nebraska area? Did they tour much?

No. They just stayed right around Omaha. Just toured around there. That was their headquarters. They just played in them little towns around it, but they stayed right there in Omaha mainly. They used to be around Dallas. They lived here, and went up there and made that their headquarters. So they stayed there, and they finally ended up out in California, San Francisco or somewhere out there, and they finally broke up.
He's not still alive?
No, he's dead.
What did he play?
He used to play bass, but he quit and hired him a bass player. He couldn't play bass no-how; he didn't know what key he was in.
Oh!
Yeah. He was just holdin' a bass. So he got him
Buster Smith - 182
a bass player. Let me see, who was playing? I did know that boy who was playing bass. I forgot now who it was. But anyway, he had a bass player who could play bass. He had a good band.
So Nat just stood up in front and waved a stick around.
Yeah.
